  \caption[{Peak-to-peak movement of the DAC reference \texttt{VddDac} across the 4096-code sweep, with the ladder\,\dots}]{Peak-to-peak movement of the DAC reference \texttt{VddDac} across the 4096-code sweep, with the ladder referenced to the on-chip supply block instead of an ideal rail. \textbf{Process and mismatch}, \texttt{castalia\_pm\_25}, 200 samples, \SI{25}{\celsius}, no external load on \texttt{VddDac}.
